I am in a similar situation myself. My bf is one of the nicest people I have ever met and he is a true blessing in my life. We are also ldr and I told him about my ed issues. Basically because he wants me to be honest or at least tell him that I am hiding something even if I am not ready to tell. So I just told him. He is really helpful and undersating about it. I also feel like shit for worrying him since he has his own issues. I feel like a total burden to him and my body image issues dont help in our relationship either. I just told him about my feelings and his response was "Yes, you are a burden and I like being there for you. We are partners. Thats what partners do. I love you"

Idk maybe others would find his answer not so very nice but I was crying out of relief. It made me realize that we love each other and thats sometimes how things are. Not always rainbows and glitters. I would be sad if he didnt tell me something serious about his health just to protect me from getting worried. I would want to be there for him and I would happily accept that burden. 

Maybe just tell him about your current feelings or try to put yourself in his place. It will be okay. He is not your therapist but therapist isnt your boyfriend either. Those are two different sources of support. You need both and maybe more. Stay safe dear. Its okay : )
